algorithm: {**The proposed algorithm is a simple variant of the Covariance Matrix Adaptation Evolution Strategy (CMA-ES), where each iteration consists of sampling candidates from the current distribution, evaluating their fitness, and updating the distribution based on the best candidate found so far.**}
{This new algorithm implements a simple grid search with adaptive sampling of new points in areas of low fitness improvement.}
{The proposed algorithm is an adaptive probabilistic iterative refinement of a randomly sampled point, leveraging gradient information to focus search on the most promising regions.}
